    colors[c] = colors.get(c, 0) + 1

    g_centers = []
    for n in g_nodes:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        cr, cc = sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols)
        g_centers.append((cr, cc))
    print(f"g centers: {g_centers}")
    
    # Click first g

    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': gr, 'col': gc}])
    print(f"\nAfter click g: {last_action_result}")
    
    seg3 = current_frame.segmentation
    colors3 = {}
    for n in seg3['nodes']:
        c = n['color']
        colors3[c] = colors3.get(c, 0) + 1
    print(f"Colors: {colors3}")
    print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
